OFFICE OF THE SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 686 (26 Sep 45) GD
(SCAPIN-63)
APO 500
26 September 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Release of Airfields.
Reference Memorandum YLO Number 33, subject:“Re-Unused Airfields,” 12 September 1945, you are advised that as rapidly as determination can be made, airfields not required by the United States Occupation Forces will be relaoased for cultivation.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ Harold Fair
/t/ HAROLD FAIR.
Lt Col, A.G.D.,
Asst. Adjutant General.
